intro.title: Guess what we've been up to.

review-letter.title: A letter for your week and month
review-letter.body: Open Review to see how you spent your time. Tap Share in the corner when you want to send it on.

badge-preview.title: Show off the badges you like
badge-preview.body: Tap Equip reward on a badge. Up to three show on your profile — you pick which.

invite-friends.title: Bring Your Friends In
invite-friends.body: Share your invite code — when a friend joins with it, you both earn a badge.

toast-icons.title: Clearer At-a-Glance Alerts
toast-icons.body: Task created, errors, warnings — every toast now comes with a small icon so you can tell what's up at a glance.
